decks.notes: This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and using disruptive spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. It includes a mix of powerful individual threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Rona's Vortex, along with efficient removal like Infernal Grasp and Make Disappear. The deck also includes ways to protect its creatures like Wedding Announcement and Cut Down, as well as card advantage engines like The Wandering Emperor and Raffine, Scheming Seer. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent casting of spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm your opponent. By playing efficient threats like The Wandering Emperor and Tenacious Underdog alongside powerful removal spells such as Cut Down and Destroy Evil, you can disrupt your opponent's game plan while applying pressure on the board. The deck also features strong card advantage engines like Raffine, Scheming Seer and Phyrexian Missionary to help maintain resources throughout the game. With a mix of versatile creatures and removal, this deck aims to win through a combination of aggression and disruption.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By combining powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sol'Kanar the Tainted with efficient removal like Infernal Grasp and Make Disappear, the deck aims to control the board and deal significant damage early on. The addition of counterspells like Spell Pierce and Negate helps protect key threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of creature abilities and powerful spells, this deck is built to apply pressure and close out games swiftly.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting opponent's strategies using a variety of removal spells and powerful threats. It also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to generate value. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by keeping their resources in check and gradually overpowering them with its powerful creatures. It also has some planeswalkers to provide additional card advantage and win conditions. The overall strategy revolves around maintaining control of the game and grinding out a victory.

The focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to dominate the game through a combination of powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Evolved Sleeper, disruption with cards like Reckoner Bankbuster and Infernal Grasp, and card advantage through cards like Tenacious Underdog and Graveyard Trespasser. The deck also utilizes planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Sorin the Mirthless to control the board and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of cards like The Meathook Massacre and Invoke Despair provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's strategy and secure victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing removal spells and creatures that disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to maintain a strong board presence while shutting down threats and gaining incremental advantages over time. By utilizing a combination of removal, disruption, and resilient threats, this deck seeks to outlast the opponent and grind out a victory through attrition and resource management. The key strategy is to control the game through a combination of removal spells, disruptive creatures, and strategic resource management.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing reanimation spells and cards that benefit from creature sacrifice, this deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bring them back into play. By combining efficient removal and disruption spells with strong reanimated threats, it seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence and close out the game before they can recover. The deck focuses on maximizing value from each card played and creating explosive turns where multiple threats can hit the battlefield at once, putting pressure on the opponent to find answers quickly.

The key strategy is to apply early pressure and maintain tempo by constantly attacking and controlling the board, while also having powerful finishers like Elspeth Resplendent and The Wandering Emperor to close out games.
